title: Patient-centric synthetic data generation, no reason to risk re-identification in biomedical data analysis
summary: Proposes the avatar method, which generates a synthetic record locally for each real patient rather than fitting one model over the cohort, and argues this bounds re-identification risk in biomedical analysis. CTGAN is one of the two comparators the method is measured against, alongside Synthpop, so CTGAN's mode-specific normalization defines the deep-learning arm of the evaluation without being run as part of the contribution.

title: Synthetic Data Generation: A Comparative Study
summary: Compares generative approaches for tabular synthesis on the twin criteria of preserving distribution and concealing sensitive values, spanning GAN, VAE, SMOTE and DataSynthesizer. SDV is one of the compared generators, so the library stands for the copula-based branch of the comparison rather than supplying the study's tooling.
evidence: abstract: SDV among generative models compared, alongside GAN, VAE, SMOTE and DataSynthesizer

title: Challenges of Using Synthetic Data Generation Methods for Tabular Microdata
summary: Evaluates GAN variants, a variational autoencoder and copulas across real datasets of varying complexity, reporting where each fails on mixed numerical and categorical microdata. Three of the four arms are SDV's: CTGAN, CopulaGAN and the copula baseline, so the paper's negative findings are largely findings about SDV's synthesizers.
evidence: abstract: evaluates CTGAN, CopulaGAN, a VAE and copulas on real datasets

title: A Comparative Analysis of GAN and VAE based Synthetic Data Generators for High Dimensional, Imbalanced Tabular data
summary: Tests whether synthetic generators still hold up when the source data is both high-dimensional and severely imbalanced, a regime where the authors argue existing evaluations are silent. CTGAN and TVAE are the two generators evaluated, so the study is a stress test of SDV's conditional sampling and its autoencoder alternative under class skew.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and TVAE evaluated on highly imbalanced high-dimensional data

title: Searching for Optimal Oversampling to Process Imbalanced Data: Generative Adversarial Networks and Synthetic Minority Over-Sampling Technique
summary: Compares oversampling strategies across a range of imbalance ratios on national health survey data, where minority classes arise from genuine incidence rates rather than sampling artefacts. CTGAN is the generative arm set against SMOTE, placing SDV's conditional sampling in direct competition with classical interpolation.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN among the oversampling techniques compared

title: A Methodology and an Empirical Analysis to Determine the Most Suitable Synthetic Data Generator
summary: Compares eleven generators drawn from three Python packages across thirteen tabular datasets, scoring each on utility, privacy and the fairness of models trained on its output, and concludes that CTGAN and PATE-CTGAN come closest to real data. SDV is one of the three packages under test and supplies the generator the study ends up recommending; the paper runs the library rather than citing it.
evidence: abstract: names Synthetic Data Vault as one of three Python packages used

title: CTTGAN: Traffic Data Synthesizing Scheme Based on Conditional GAN
summary: Addresses class imbalance in malicious-traffic identification by synthesizing minority-class samples, reporting recognition above 0.99 for MLP, KNN and SVM on the rebalanced set and improvement over oversampling and undersampling. CTTGAN takes CTGAN's conditional generator and its joint handling of discrete and continuous columns and retargets them at network traffic features; the entry records a derivative model, not a use of the library.

evidence: abstract: CTTGAN is a traffic-specific model built on CTGAN

title: Energy absorption analysis of origami structures based on small number of samples using conditional GAN
summary: Builds a data-driven framework for predicting energy absorption in origami-inspired metamaterials, where each training sample requires an expensive folding simulation and datasets are therefore tiny. CTGAN's conditional generation supplies the additional samples the surrogate model needs, an application of SDV in mechanical metamaterial design rather than record synthesis.
evidence: abstract: data-driven framework built on CTGAN for small-sample settings

title: Measuring re-identification risk using a synthetic estimator to enable data sharing
summary: Develops a risk estimator for the sample-to-population attack, where an adversary picks a record from released microdata and tries to match it against the population, and validates it across health datasets. The estimator is copula-based: Gaussian and d-vine copula variants are compared, which places the vine copula line of SDV research inside a privacy-measurement method rather than a generator.
affiliations: University of Ottawa; Children's Hospital of Eastern Ontario
evidence: abstract: Gaussian copula and d-vine copula estimators compared

title: Synthetic Data as a Proxy for Real-World Electronic Health Records in the Patient Length of Stay Prediction
summary: Tests whether synthetic electronic health records can stand in for real ones when predicting patient length of stay, a task where data scarcity and privacy restrictions bite hardest. CTGAN and CopulaGAN are the two models selected to produce the substitute records, so SDV supplies the data the clinical prediction task is then evaluated on.
affiliations: Universität Hamburg; FOM University of Applied Sciences for Economics and Management
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and CopulaGAN selected as the underlying models

title: Generating Synthetic Data to Reduce Prediction Error of Energy Consumption
summary: Targets the forecasting errors that cause energy suppliers to over- or under-contract capacity, arguing that the training data available is too sparse for reliable prediction. The contribution is architectural rather than applied: TGAN-skip-Improved-WGAN-GP extends TGAN with skip connections and a modified objective, making this a named descendant of the first-party tabular GAN.
evidence: abstract: proposes TGAN-skip-Improved-WGAN-GP, an architectural extension of TGAN

title: Prediction and reliability analysis of ultimate axial strength for outer circular CFRP-strengthened CFST columns with CTGAN and hybrid MFO-ET model
summary: Predicts the ultimate axial strength of fibre-reinforced concrete-filled steel tube columns, where experimental specimens are costly and the test database is correspondingly small. CTGAN is named in the title as the augmentation step feeding the hybrid predictor, though no abstract is indexed and the role is inferred from the title and the record's CTGAN signal rather than read from the text.
affiliations: Seoul National University of Science and Technology
evidence: title names CTGAN as the augmentation method; no abstract indexed
needs: fetch the full text and confirm which CTGAN implementation is used and how

title: SynGen: Synthetic Data Generation
summary: Describes a platform for generating datasets on demand, aimed at practising data-science techniques without exposing real samples. It is assembled from two pieces: Faker for identifier-shaped columns and a Gaussian copula for the statistical structure, the same split SDV makes between fabricated fields and fitted distributions.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian copula used to build a dataset generation platform

title: Real-time earthquake magnitude prediction using designed machine learning ensemble trained on real and CTGAN generated synthetic data
summary: Estimates earthquake magnitude from P-wave precursor features for early warning, where the Japanese catalogue is heavily skewed against the high-impact events that matter most. CTGAN learns the first-arrival characteristics and generates the missing strong-event records, so SDV addresses a class imbalance whose minority class is the one the system exists to catch.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN learns P-wave first-arrival characteristics to generate training data

title: Evaluation of Synthetic Data Generation Techniques in the Domain of Anonymous Traffic Classification
summary: Assesses whether synthetic data fixes the skew that makes VPN and Tor traffic classifiers fail on real network conditions, comparing generators on the resulting classification accuracy. CTGAN and CopulaGAN are two of the four arms, set against a VAE and SMOTE, so SDV's synthesizers are measured against both a deep and a classical alternative.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and CopulaGAN compared against VAE and SMOTE

title: Generative adversarial network approach for predicting tensile behavior and failure pattern of fiber-reinforced cementitious matrices
summary: Builds a predictive framework for the tensile strength, ultimate strain and failure pattern of fibre-reinforced cementitious matrices used in infrastructure rehabilitation, where inconsistent coupon testing has left no reliable design model. CTGAN generates the additional coupon records the framework trains on, making SDV the augmentation layer under a civil-engineering design tool.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN-based framework estimates tensile strength

title: RCT-Twin-GAN Generates Digital Twins of Randomized Control Trials Adapted to Real-world Patients
summary: Simulates randomized trial effects in real-world populations by generating a digital twin of a trial whose covariate patterns match an electronic health record, addressing the historical underrepresentation of key groups in trial cohorts. The model is CTGAN modified: an adapted loss and multi-covariate conditioning are layered onto its conditional architecture, making this a named clinical derivative rather than a use.
affiliations: Yale New Haven Hospital; Yale University
evidence: abstract: improves on CTGAN with an adapted loss and multi-covariate conditioning

title: Advancing breast cancer prediction: comparative analysis of ML models and deep learning-based multi-model ensembles on original and synthetic datasets
summary: Compares classical learners, ensembles, AutoML and deep models for breast cancer diagnosis, running each against both the original data and synthetic expansions of it. The Gaussian Copula synthesizer and TVAE generate those expansions, so SDV determines the synthetic half of every comparison the paper reports.
affiliations: Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula and TVAE used for synthetic data generation phases

title: Development of machine learning-based burst capacity models for pipelines containing dent-gouges
summary: Derives burst capacity models for oil and gas pipelines with dent-gouge damage from a full-scale test database of only 88 specimens, since destructive testing at that scale is prohibitively expensive. TGAN expands the test set before three tree-based learners are fitted, putting the first-party tabular GAN under a pipeline integrity model.
evidence: abstract: tabular GAN expands 88 full-scale burst tests

title: Rigorous Experimental Analysis of Tabular Data Generated using TVAE and CTGAN
summary: Examines how CTGAN and TVAE behave as dataset scale varies, arguing that published comparisons rarely separate model quality from the size of the data each was fitted on. Both models under test are SDV's, so the paper is an experimental account of SDV's two deep synthesizers rather than a survey that happens to include them.
venue: International Journal of Advanced Computer Science and Applications
evidence: abstract: comparative analysis of CTGAN and TVAE across dataset scales

title: High-resolution flood probability mapping using generative machine learning with large-scale synthetic precipitation and inundation data
summary: Produces high-resolution flood probability maps without the historical record or the physics simulation runs such maps normally require, both of which are limiting for most catchments. CTGAN conditionally generates synthetic precipitation point clouds that stand in for the missing events, an unusually spatial application of SDV's conditional sampling.
affiliations: Texas A&M University – San Antonio; Texas A&M University
evidence: abstract: CTGAN conditionally generates synthetic precipitation point clouds

title: Towards Autonomous Cybersecurity: An Intelligent AutoML Framework for Autonomous Intrusion Detection
summary: Proposes an AutoML framework for intrusion detection in zero-touch mobile networks, automating the pipeline steps a human analyst would otherwise tune. TVAE is the automated data-balancing stage inside that pipeline, so SDV's autoencoder synthesizer runs as a component of an autonomous system rather than as an object of study.
evidence: abstract: TVAE used for automated data balancing inside the AutoML pipeline

title: CTGAN-Based Model to Mitigate Data Scarcity for Cost Estimation in Green Building Projects
summary: Estimates construction costs at the early project stage, where owners of green building projects have too few comparable past projects to reason from and cannot separate green-specific costs from baseline ones. CTGAN generates the missing comparables, and the title makes SDV's synthesizer the named basis of the method.
evidence: abstract: CTGANs used for data augmentation against data scarcity

title: Use of Synthetic Data in Maritime Applications for the Problem of Steam Turbine Exergy Analysis
summary: Models steam turbine exergy for marine propulsion, a setting where instrumented measurements are expensive to collect and datasets stay small. TVAE, copulas and CTGAN all generate training data for the downstream models, so three separate SDV synthesizers are compared inside one engineering application.
venue: Journal of Marine Science and Engineering
evidence: abstract: TVAE, copulas and CTGAN used to generate training data

title: Machine learning enhanced bridge vulnerability quantification under rockfall hazards
summary: Joins rockfall trajectory modelling to structural impact simulation so that bridge vulnerability in mountainous terrain can be quantified end to end, rather than through the two disconnected analyses the field usually runs. TGAN augments the finite-element restart output, standing in for simulation runs too costly to repeat at the sample sizes machine learning wants.
affiliations: Chang'an University; China Institute of Water Resources and Hydropower Research
evidence: abstract: TGAN augmentation applied to finite element restart analysis output

title: Utility-based Analysis of Statistical Approaches and Deep Learning Models for Synthetic Data Generation With Focus on Correlation Structures
summary: Compares seven synthesis approaches on how faithfully each reproduces correlation structure rather than marginal distributions alone, arguing that utility claims in medical synthesis usually rest on the weaker test. Four of the seven are SDV's, copula, CopulaGAN, CTGAN and TVAE, so the study is largely an audit of how well SDV's model family preserves dependence.
evidence: abstract: copula, copulagan, ctgan and tvae among the seven approaches compared

title: The Explanation and Sensitivity of AI Algorithms Supplied with Synthetic Medical Data
summary: Measures how model explanations shift when an algorithm is fed real data, synthetic data, a mixture, or synthetic features, across two clinical datasets. The Gaussian Copula Synthesizer produces every synthetic variant, so SDV determines the perturbation whose effect on interpretability the paper reports.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula Synthesizer applied to two medical datasets

title: SleepSynth: Evaluating the use of Synthetic Data in Health Digital Twins
summary: Asks whether synthetic records are good enough to build health digital twins on, given that patient data is both privacy-restricted and demographically skewed. Four SDV synthesizers, Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE, are evaluated on sleep data, making the paper a comparison within SDV's own model family rather than against outside alternatives.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula, CTGAN, CopulaGAN and TVAE evaluated on sleep data

title: Towards Developing a Robust Intrusion Detection Model Using Hadoop-Spark and Data Augmentation for IoT Networks
summary: Builds an intrusion detection model over IoT network traffic on a distributed Hadoop and Spark stack, where detection quality is bounded by how few samples the rarer attack classes contribute. CTGAN generates the minority-class records in the BoT-IoT dataset, so SDV supplies the rebalancing step of a production-shaped security pipeline.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN used to generate minority-class samples in the BoT-IoT dataset

title: Generating Time-Series Data Using Generative Adversarial Networks for Mobility Demand Prediction
summary: Forecasts demand for free-floating electric kickboard rentals, where the deployment is new and the operating history correspondingly thin. TGAN-Modified-WGAN-GP is proposed to address mode collapse in the generator, another named architectural descendant of the first-party tabular GAN rather than an application of it.
evidence: abstract: TGAN-Modified-WGAN-GP proposed to address mode collapse

title: TGANs with Machine Learning Models in Automobile Insurance Fraud Detection
summary: Separates fraud detection into a preprocessing phase and a classification phase and asks whether the choice made in the first constrains what the second can achieve. TGAN is the generative option set against SMOTE, MWMOTE and ADASYN, so the first-party tabular GAN is benchmarked against three classical oversamplers on insurance claims.
affiliations: Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning
Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning
Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning
venue: International Journal of Recent Technology and Engineering
evidence: abstract: TGAN compared with SMOTE, MWMOTE and ADASYN for imbalance handling

title: GenAI-Based Jamming and Spoofing Attacks on UAVs
summary: Studies jamming and spoofing against unmanned aerial vehicles, where building an intrusion detector is blocked by the scarcity of recorded attack data. The Gaussian Copula synthesizer and CTGAN are two of four generators used to manufacture that attack data, so SDV supplies the adversarial examples a defence is then trained on.
evidence: abstract: Gaussian Copula and CTGAN among four generators of synthetic attack data

title: Generative Synthesis of Insurance Datasets
summary: Argues that actuarial research is held back by the absence of realistic public datasets, and builds a workflow that synthesizes shareable insurance data from restricted sources. CTGAN is the generator that workflow is built around, an early application of the architecture to a field whose data almost never leaves the firm that holds it.
evidence: abstract: workflow for synthesizing insurance datasets leveraging CTGAN

title: Synthetic Time Series Data in Groundwater Analytics: Challenges, Insights, and Applications
summary: Generates synthetic groundwater level series from USGS National Water Information System records to support aquifer management where monitoring wells are sparse. It names the SDV framework explicitly and uses the Probabilistic AutoRegressive synthesizer, which makes this one of the clearest uses of PAR outside the first-party sequential work.
evidence: abstract: employs the SDV framework's Probabilistic AutoRegressive (PAR) synthesizer on USGS data

title: Permutation-Invariant Tabular Data Synthesis
summary: Shows that state-of-the-art tabular synthesizers are sensitive to the order of the input columns, a dependence that should not exist for data with no intrinsic column ordering, and proposes a permutation-invariant treatment. CTGAN and TVAE are among the models whose sensitivity is demonstrated, so the criticism lands directly on SDV's synthesizers.
affiliations: 5T Torino (Italy); Torino e-district; University of Turin
venue: IEEE International Conference on Big Data
evidence: abstract: CTGAN and TVAE are baselines whose sensitivity to column permutation the paper critiques

title: Generating Synthetic Tabular Data for DDoS Detection Using Generative Models
summary: Addresses the shortage of labelled attack flows that limits intrusion detection for distributed denial-of-service traffic. CTGAN, TVAE and CopulaGAN all synthesise the missing flow records, so all three of SDV's single-table deep synthesizers are exercised against one security dataset.
evidence: abstract: CTGAN, TVAE and CopulaGAN used to synthesise attack flow data

title: Applying Deep Generative Neural Networks to Data Augmentation for Consumer Survey Data with a Small Sample Size
summary: Tackles the two constraints that keep marketing surveys small, budget and the rarity of the populations worth sampling, by expanding a seed sample rather than collecting more responses. CTGAN, TVAE and CopulaGAN are applied to that seed, making SDV the mechanism by which a small survey is treated as a large one.
affiliations: Prefectural University of Hiroshima; University of Marketing and Distribution Sciences
evidence: abstract: CTGAN, TVAE and CopulaGAN applied to seed survey data

title: Medical data sharing and synthetic clinical data generation - maximizing biomedical resource utilization and minimizing participant re-identification risks
summary: Presents a titratable pipeline that turns electronic health records and wearable data from three thousand participants into shareable digital twin datasets, letting the operator trade utility against re-identification risk. SDV is one of the two named method families the pipeline is built on, alongside DataSifter, so the library is infrastructure for a data-sharing protocol rather than a compared generator.
evidence: abstract: pipeline built on DataSifter and Synthetic Data Vault methods over EHR and wearable data
